instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: He partook in the obstacle course.
Out of all arguments delivered, his were the most reasonable.
atoms.b: Out of all arguments delivered, his were the most ((reasonable)).

atoms.a: She found a nicer path for a walk, parallel to the road.
atoms.b: She found a nicer path for a walk, ((parallel)) to the road.

atoms.a: It took her family a while to accept her newly found principle, but they eventually did.
atoms.b: It took her family a while to accept her newly found ((principle)), but they eventually did.

atoms.a: Claudia learnt to drive a vehicle for the first time in her life when she was 17 years old.
atoms.b: Claudia learnt to drive a ((vehicle)) for the first time in her life when she was 17 years old.

atoms.a: The US has valuable resources such as gold, copper and natural gas.
atoms.b: The US has ((valuable)) resources such as gold, copper and natural gas.
